snippet.title: D3ad Hand - Adventure Game Jam Version
snippet.description:
Yuri Spraytyvich has been selected for the role of Junior Strategic Missile Force Manager of Čerëmuški Command Post in Chita, Siberia. 

Play full game here: https://duckofwood.itch.io/d3ad-hand

Theme music: Red Square by Melodyayresgriffiths (https://pixabay.com/users/melodyayresgriffiths-27269767/?tab=audio)

His new position comes with a lot of responsabilities and he will need to deal with lack of maintenance, worker strikes, radioactive materials and PERIMETER, the automatic defence system. 

When PERIMETER receives by mistake the order to start the launch of the ballistic missile it is up to Yuri to fix the problems and save the world from the nuclear apocalypse. 

D3AD HAND is a satirical graphic adventure inspired by Lucas Art golden age videogames like Monkey Island and the Indiana Jones series. 

DISCLAIMER: The game does NOT support WAR in any form or shape, quite the contrary.
